scope: Local checkout remedies; no production deployment
status: all six audit findings remedied and verified locally

findings.title: Yen have a visible purpose.
findings.evidence: Actual service simulations show daily visitors still saving for the final project on day 42; weekly visitors afford all core rewards and two projects. Browser purchase → room change → reload passes. Authenticated backend checks prove server pricing, authorization and exactly-once debit.

findings.title: The two empty income steps now pay off.
findings.evidence: Domain and browser checks compare preview, actual purchased state and announcement. Generic equal-capacity explanations name the future bottleneck. Legacy license owners retain their purchased benefit; previews explain bonuses already received.

findings.title: The first renovation fits a short visit.
findings.evidence: A zero-yen, bronze-qualified browser fixture advances exactly five minutes, collects ¥50, buys the prep counter, and ends at ¥0 with 20 ¥/min. The same boundary is tested through the real domain service.

findings.title: The register respects daily study rhythms.
findings.evidence: Fixed-rate daily and twice-daily collection earn the same total. The modeled route differs by just ¥7,200 because an earlier visit buys the first upgrade earlier. Migration tests verify old capped earnings, discarded stopped time and idempotent future-only changes.

findings.title: Every gold achievement has a permanent home.
findings.evidence: Domain tests check permanent grants independently of current progress. Browser fixtures show all seven honors with an empty wallet, no inventory and both decor slots empty; they persist after reload.

findings.title: Goals explain their value; guests teach the course.
findings.evidence: A service-limited restaurant recommends the conveyor ahead of cosmetics; switching goal type changes the suggestion. Browser checks verify selected chapter, source, reveal and next, while course records, grants, inventory and yen remain unchanged.

economyPolicy: Start at zero. All three chapter grants unlock every seven days; collect each visit, then buy eligible core bronze items, visual catalog items, then optional projects in catalog order. No active study earnings or starter cash.
